groups.definition: Acquisitions, joint ventures and investments may fail to obtain regulatory approvals or be successfully integrated, harming results.
Existing or additional debt increases leverage, which may restrict financing, acquisitions and competitiveness and risk covenant defaults.

groups.canonical_name: Captive finance arm funding and credit risk
groups.definition: The captive finance subsidiary depends on capital market funding and is exposed to loan losses and residual values, affecting support for vehicle sales.

groups.canonical_name: Credit rating downgrade raising borrowing costs
groups.definition: A downgrade of credit ratings could increase borrowing costs and reduce access to financing.

groups.canonical_name: Debt service burden on cash flow
groups.definition: Substantial indebtedness requires diverting cash flow to principal and interest payments, reducing funds for other uses.
Declines in business value may require goodwill impairment charges that reduce earnings.
Foreign and outbound investment control regimes may block or limit acquisitions and alliances.

groups.canonical_name: Joint venture compliance and misconduct exposure
groups.definition: Limited control over joint ventures may lead to governance or compliance failures causing fines and reputational harm.

groups.canonical_name: Joint venture funding and execution shortfall
groups.definition: Joint ventures and alliances may impose funding obligations and fail to meet production timing or quality targets.

groups.canonical_name: Refinancing risk and insufficient debt service cash
groups.definition: The company may be unable to refinance debt or may refinance only at higher rates with more onerous covenants.

groups.canonical_name: Restructuring and strategic change execution risk
groups.definition: Restructuring and strategic changes may incur costs, disrupt customers and operations, and fail to deliver expected benefits.
